name: sink
description: Keep a value observable so a compiler cannot eliminate the work that produced it.

name: rand
description: Draw an integer from the requested range.

name: random_array
description: Allocate and populate an array before the timed section.
go:
arr := make([]byte, n)
for i := range arr { arr[i] = byte(rand.IntN(256)) }

name: flush_cache
description: Evict cached data where supported. An eviction buffer is an approximation.

name: align
description: Round a size up to an alignment boundary.

name: allocate
description: Reserve a writable region of memory.

name: free
description: Release the buffer outside the timed section.

name: mmap
description: Map a memory region through the operating system.
go: region, err := unix.Mmap(-1, 0, n, unix.PROT_READ|unix.PROT_WRITE, unix.MAP_ANON|unix.MAP_PRIVATE)

name: open
description: Open a file and return a handle.

name: close
description: Close a file or mapped region.

name: io_read
description: Read bytes from an open handle.
go:
data := make([]byte, n)
count, err := fd.Read(data)

name: gen_file
description: Prepare a file before starting the timed loop.

name: linear_search
description: Scan elements in order until the key is found.

name: binary_search
description: Find a key in sorted data by repeatedly halving the search space.

name: hashmap_lookup
description: Look up a value by key in a hash map.
